checks.result: 19 skills match all 57 M0 golden cases (incl. Storm Gust tick times and per-tick freeze intent). Every Active at every level 1-10 resolved in the engine probe and produced every effect; Spell Breaker interrupted enemy casts (credited via cast_interrupt.action_id) and drained SP, Dispel removed enemy buffs. Every Passive changes stats or procs at levels 1-10. Wizard/Sage skill pages list only root+own-branch skills with effect text; all 19 resolve pack visuals.

Sage with Meteor + Auto-bolt: 18 normal attacks, none inside any of 11 cast windows; 8 Auto-bolt hits all from normal actions with exactly one proc per triggering hit (no recursion). Storm Gust: 14 frost-field instances tick at exactly +1000/2000/3000/4000 ms (never at the 5000 ms expiry), each tick rolls Freeze once per target (8 freezes on ['e_back', 'e_front']).

catalogQueueTrace of all 4 builds equals the M0 queue_estimate incl. Sage Auto-bolt cast speed 164.64 / attack speed 150 / cycle 7344 ms. Full fights keep the dry first cycle (no self-timing buffs in this tree), while Quagmire's slow really lengthens the enemy's swing gap ([1999, 1999] vs base 1399 ms).

Story 6-20 seed 32 with main Wizard controller + Sage NPC swapped into the Archer slot: server (62 confirmed checkpoints), client session with render views and runner give the identical final checkpoint, RNG and 647 events (digest db55e84a), outcome STORY_WON at 62210 ms; frost-field ticks keep the Storm Gust cast as source.

limitations: No new visuals: icons per skill, in-battle effects reuse family recipes (Storm Gust keeps its native STR effect).
